Container.Name: Simple Finance
Container.Overview:
Private household spending tracker for two people: fast mobile entry at the till, recurring payments with a read-only month calendar, honest "available now" estimates and a payday-to-payday projection, per-vehicle running costs, supplier contact cards, contract-end and renewal alerts, receipt/invoice attachments, and encrypted downloadable backups.
Access is through Cloudflare Tunnel + Access (Google sign-in) with an allowlist of exactly two identities; the app verifies the Access JWT itself. Keep this container off the public internet.
Container.Description: Simple Finance (v0.3.0). Internal port 3000; choose a free host port. Data lives in /mnt/user/appdata/simple-finance (database, .env, documents, logging). Health endpoint: /api/health. Backups: Settings → Backup & restore (encrypted archive of the database and every attachment).

Config.Name: WebUI (host port)
Config.Description: Pick a free host port on your server; the container always listens on 3000. Cloudflare Tunnel points at this host port.

Config.Name: Appdata (/data)
Config.Description: Database (+WAL/SHM), .env, documents/ (receipts) and logging/. Fixed by the product owner — do not relocate without reading docs/SPEC.md §18.1.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the data directory. Unraid's nobody is 99; the entrypoint aligns ownership once, then the app runs as this user (never root).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the data directory. Unraid's users group is 100.

Config.Name: AUTH_ISSUER
Config.Description: Cloudflare Access team URL, e.g. https://your-team.cloudflareaccess.com. Optional here — values in /data/.env override the template.

Config.Name: AUTH_AUDIENCE
Config.Description: The Access application's AUD tag. Optional here — values in /data/.env override the template.

Config.Name: AUTH_ALLOWED_EMAILS
Config.Description: Exactly the two household identities, comma-separated. Optional here — values in /data/.env override the template.
